1. च्यु (and च्युस्), cl. 10. च्यावयति (च्योसय्˚) = √ सह् or हस्, Dhātup. xxxiii, 72.

See √ 1. च्यु;
 cl. 10. च्योसयति, to leave, Dhātup. xxxiii, 72.
‘shaking, causing to fall, removing, destroying’, see अच्युत-, ध्रुव-, पर्वत-, बाहु-, मद-च्यु॑त्.
1. च्युत॑ mfn. moved, shaken, AV. ix, 2, 15
gone away from (abl.), R. ii, 52, 27 and 72, 5
(with abl. or ifc.) deviated from (lit. [Pañcat. v, 3, 10/11] and fig. [Mn. viii, 418; xii, 70 ff.;
(said of arrows) failing an aim (abl.), L.
flying away from (abl. or in comp.; said of missile weapons), MBh. xiii, 4610;
expelled from, deprived of (abl.), MBh. iii; Bhaṭṭ. vii, 92
destitute of, free of (in comp.), Pañcat. i, 10, 26; Kathās. lx, 178
come forth from, dropped from, streaming forth from (lit. and fig., as speech from the mouth), Mn. vi, 132; MBh. xiii, 2183; R. i-iii; BhP.; Bhaṭṭ. ix, 71
fallen from any divine existence for being re-born as a man, Buddh.; Jain.

2. च्युत mfn. ifc. id. See घृत-, मधु-.
v.l. for चूत, the anus, W.
च्युत—दत्ताक्षर mf(आ)n. where a syllable has been dropped or added, Sāh. x, 14.
च्युत—पथक m. ‘deviated from the path’, N. of a pupil of Śākyamuni, Buddh.; L.
च्युत—संस्कार mfn. offending against grammar, Pratāpar.
च्युत—संस्कृति mfn. id., ib.; Kpr. vii, 2.
mf(आ)n. where a syllable has been dropped, Sāh. x, 14/15.
‘banishment’, see देश-, ‘coming forth’, see गर्भ-, ‘oozing’, see जघ॑न-
falling, falling down, gliding, Gaut.; Suśr.
fall from any divine existence (so as to be re-born as a man), Lalit. iv, 4 and 31; HPariś.
vanishment, loss (ifc.), Suśr.; Kum. iii, 10; Śāntiś.; BhP. x, 22, 20
